The 08:40:00Z manual header is stamped before the call, as the poller's is, so it cannot slip past 08:40:36Z. Three concrete gaps, none of them a rule rewrite. (1) The only night-read watcher (PID 16292) exits at the FIRST of the three refs to finish, which is expected to be exp89p at ~07:47Z. Nothing re-arms it, so exp89r's read (~09:25Z, the A-M2 driver) may wait for the 10:13Z round or the 11:10Z check. The M2 non-CI read would then slide toward or past 18:37Z. (2) R31-A1 applies GAP RULE v2's CI threshold of 10.2 h to P, but exp89p is non-CI safetail with an 8.0 h insertion gate. A late, depressed P can fake DIS '+' or P '0'. This is a low-probability case: 0 of 12 family reads exceeded 7.81 h. (3) After 12:00Z the e10 loop has ended, and the exp89l and M2 reads can land in the same hour. The morning late-read watchers should take one LB save at each terminal header, so that an equal-display UP stays attributable.

After exp89p fires, the next scheduled wake-ups are the 08:13Z / 09:13Z rounds (both before exp89r is due), the 10:13Z round and the 11:10Z deadline check. A-M2 can therefore be sent 40-100 min late. An M2 file is non-CI, with L 7.0-7.8 h. Sent ~09:40Z it reads ~16:40-17:30Z. Sent ~10:20-11:15Z it reads ~17:20-19:05Z, which is at or past the 18:37Z FINAL proposal and the R31-A3 'a read after ~19:30Z cannot be a final' line. exp75's read (the partner rule, card only) has no watcher either.

findings.what: The late-read threshold for P (exp89p) uses the CI family's 10.2 h gate instead of exp89p's own non-CI insertion gate of 8.0 h. R31-A1 (1) says 'GAP RULE v2 still applies to P: a 0/- read with L_hi > 10.2 h (after ~10:58:36Z) is ?'. exp89p's family is safetail (non-CI): deadline 9.5 h, insertion gate 8.0 h. With L_hi in (8.0, 10.2] h the insertion step may have been skipped on the last clips, and that can only lower d_P. Under the current text such a read still counts as clean, with two effects. (a) MORNING TABLE v1.1 (1): dd = (d_R - d_P) - (0.959 - 0.958). A depressed d_P inflates dd, so a false DIS '+' sends exp89s. Example: exp89p 0.956 because the insertion was skipped, exp89r 0.960 -> dd 0.003 -> exp89s. (b) A false P '0'/'-' makes A-M2 UNUSED (02:02Z (3)) and 'removes SEC' on the card. A '+' read and a DIS '-' read stay robust, because the error runs one way only. A-M1 is unaffected (it already requires L_hi <= 7.9 h). The card's non-CI pool text already says 'L_hi > 8.0 h: v suffix, insertion gate may have fired', so the rules disagree with each other.
findings.evidence: CONTEXT 02:53Z (1) (R31-A1) l.4311-4312; MORNING TABLE v1.1 (14:12Z) (1) dd definition; tools/runtime_ledger.py FAMILIES 'safetail' deadline 9.5 h, DIVINS_GATE_H 8.0; experiments/lb_poll/ledger.md row 56657612 'insertion gate 8.0 h: open'; card v5 l.17 (non-CI pool, v suffix above 8.0 h). Probability is low: non-CI safetail reads (ledger) are exp85a (7.01, 7.19], exp78a/b, exp70a/b/d/e/g/j/k/q and exp58, spanning 6.87-7.81 h; 0 of 12 exceed 8.0 h. exp89p's 8.0 h mark = 00:46:36Z + 8.0 h = 08:46:36Z.

findings.what: After 12:00Z, UP tests for the morning files can go MASKED unnecessarily. e10_watch_loop.py ends at 12:00Z (END, l.64), so after that the only LB snapshots are the xx:13Z snapshots of the research-round agents. The two morning files likely read close together. exp89l is CI: sent ~07:55Z it reads ~17:15-17:25Z. M2 is non-CI: sent ~09:40Z it reads ~16:40-17:30Z. Both can complete inside one hourly gap, so the next snapshot shows our count +2. Under the +2 rule, equal displays are MASKED, and under 02:02Z (2) the running champion then stays. The equal-display case is realistic: exp89l = exp89r minus DIS, and the M2 file sits beside the top file. This only matters for V_pub when a morning file reads at the top display. R32-A2 allows a fresh 'timeout 180 python tools/uptest.py save' but does not say WHEN to take it. Taken at the 18:37Z fill, both reads are already inside it.

findings.action: When arming each morning late-read watcher (R30-A2 'after each submit'), append one LB save to the same background command, so that it runs at the terminal header without waiting for the session: ... until last | grep -qE "^<REF>,.*(COMPLETE|ERROR)"; do sleep 120; done; date -u +%H:%M:%S; last | grep -E "^===|^<REF>,"; timeout 180 python tools/uptest.py save post_<token>. That is 1 Kaggle call per morning file, at most 2 in total. S0 = any e10 snapshot or save taken after the last night read with our count unchanged (the 12:13Z round snapshot will do); compare with python tools/uptest.py compare <S0> post_<token>. The procedure only; no rule change.
